messages.content: My overtime on this week's payslip looks low. I did four 12-hour nights and a 6 on Friday. Why?

content.content:
payslip week Jan 10 to 16, 2028, paid Jan 21
provider gross paid $2197.40
provider overtime: 14 h x 1.5 x base $31.40
Hartwell rule recalculation:
HES-40217 week, TX, ruleset US-PAY v1.2
R-BASE  54 h x $31.40               $  1695.60
R-NIGHT 48 h x $2.75                $   132.00
R-BONUS weekly bonus                $   150.00
R-OT    14 h x 0.5 x $36.6222       $   256.36
gross                               $  2233.96
paid $36.56 less than the rule
payroll query PQ-28-0117 opened Jan 21 by the recalculation check; owner US payroll manager; any correction is paid by off-cycle payment

content.text:
Your payslip is under-paid by $36.56 compared with the rule recalculation. The recalculation counts 14 overtime hours at the half-time premium, R-OT $256.36 (14 h x 0.5 x $36.6222). The provider's overtime line instead shows 14 h x 1.5 x base $31.40, so the two methods don't match.

The rule recalculation gives gross pay of $2233.96, while the amount paid is $2197.40. The recalculation also includes 54 base hours at $1695.60, 48 night hours at $132.00 and a $150.00 weekly bonus.

Payroll query PQ-28-0117 was opened today by this check and sits with the US payroll manager. Any correction would be paid as an off-cycle payment. I can't change your pay myself, but I can send your details to the payroll team to follow up on the query. Would you like me to do that?

messages.content: I am leaving at the end of March after six years in Dubai. How much gratuity will I get?

content.content:
estimate for HME-DXB-0311, UAE, rule UAE-EOS v1.0
service February 1, 2022 to March 31, 2028, unpaid leave 0 days: 6.1671 years
basic wage AED 3,800 a month; day = basic / 30
first 5 years x 21 days; after 5 years x 30 days
estimated gratuity AED 17,734.98
final statement by Gulf payroll (Hyderabad) on the last working day; paid with final wages

content.text:
Your estimate is **AED 17,734.98**, based on 6.1671 years of service from February 1, 2022 to March 31, 2028, with no unpaid leave.

The estimate uses a basic wage of AED 3,800 a month. The first 5 years count at 21 days per year, and the years after that at 30 days per year.

This is an estimate. Gulf payroll (Hyderabad) will issue the final statement on your last working day, and the gratuity is paid with your final wages. If your last day changes or you take unpaid leave, the figure will change too.

stdout: S1 HES-40217: My overtime on this week's payslip looks low. I did four 12-hour nights and a 6 on Friday. Why?
tools: get_payslip
> Your payslip is under-paid by $36.56 compared with the rule
> recalculation. The recalculation counts 14 overtime hours at
> the half-time premium, R-OT $256.36 (14 h x 0.5 x $36.6222).
> The provider's overtime line instead shows 14 h x 1.5 x base
> $31.40, so the two methods don't match.  The rule
> recalculation gives gross pay of $2233.96, while the amount
> paid is $2197.40. The recalculation also includes 54 base
> hours at $1695.60, 48 night hours at $132.00 and a $150.00
> weekly bonus.  Payroll query PQ-28-0117 was opened today by
> this check and sits with the US payroll manager. Any
> correction would be paid as an off-cycle payment. I can't
> change your pay myself, but I can send your details to the
> payroll team to follow up on the query. Would you like me to
> do that?
